axes.right: +Z (the fighter's right hand, the camera side)
axes.matrices: column-major 4x4, model (fighter-local) space, bind pose unless noted
axes.blender: edlib converts once: blender (x, y, z) = game (-z, -x, y); game (x, y, z) = blender (-y, z, -x). In Blender the hero faces -Y, Z is up, the right hand is at -X
axes.bind: A-pose the meshes are authored in (arms 28 deg abducted, 8 deg forward, elbows 14 deg; thighs 3 deg out)
axes.zero: every authored rotation 0: limbs hang straight down, bone frames parallel to the model axes
